t: Signature ROS 2: What ROS 2 Is: Plumbing for Robots
title: Signature ROS 2: What ROS 2 Is: Plumbing for Robots
description: The Signature counterpart is the SigSwarm bus, Manon's original robotics-middleware design. SigSwarm mirrors the node/topic/service model but every node carries a signed identity and every topic a schema hash; a node cannot publish to a topic whose schema it has not proven it implements. The Signature design makes interface mismatch a deployment-time error, never a runtime surprise.
